// This fixture compiles against the installed tarball, not Postern's sources.
import {
  connect,
  type Connection,
  type ConnectionWithLabels,
  type IssueTracker,
  type IssueTrackerWithLabels,
  type Label,
} from "@lutzseverino/postern";

const unused = (): never => { throw new Error("compile fixture only"); };

// Freeze the pre-label-management producer shape: neither new method is needed.
export const legacyTracker: IssueTracker = {
  capabilities: {},
  issueEvent: unused,
  issues: unused,
  issue: unused,
  labelChanges: unused,
  comments: unused,
  addLabels: unused,
  removeLabel: unused,
  createLabel: unused,
  createComment: unused,
  updateComment: unused,
  closeIssue: unused,
};

declare const pullRequests: Connection["pullRequests"];
declare const releaseSource: Connection["releaseSource"];
declare const access: Connection["access"];
export const legacyConnection: Connection = {
  repository: { platform: "github", host: "github.com", path: "octo/hello" },
  issueTracker: legacyTracker,
  pullRequests,
  releaseSource,
  access,
};

type Assert<T extends true> = T;
export type LegacyTrackerHasNoLabelOperations = Assert<
  Extract<keyof IssueTracker, "labels" | "updateLabel"> extends never ? true : false
>;

const concrete = connect("https://github.com/octo/hello");
export const labels: Promise<Label[]> = concrete.issueTracker.labels();
export const updated: Promise<Label> = concrete.issueTracker.updateLabel("old", {
  name: "new", color: "abcdef", description: "",
});

// The stronger inferred result is still assignable to the old named contracts.
export const oldConnection: Connection = concrete;
export const oldTracker: IssueTracker = concrete.issueTracker;
export const refined: ConnectionWithLabels = concrete;
export const extended: IssueTrackerWithLabels = concrete.issueTracker;

// Adapter harnesses can name the additive contract and require both methods.
export function harness(tracker: IssueTrackerWithLabels): Promise<Label[]> {
  const required: {
    labels(): Promise<Label[]>;
    updateLabel(name: string, label: Label): Promise<Label>;
  } = tracker;
  return required.labels();
}
